## Common WHERE Filters

### 分区与基础过滤
```sql
WHERE grass_date = date('${RUN_TIME}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
```

### 曝光/点击过滤
```sql
WHERE operation = 1  -- Impression
WHERE operation = 2  -- Click
WHERE operation in (1, 2)  -- 曝光+点击
```

### 反作弊与去重过滤
```sql
WHERE (fraud_type IS NULL OR fraud_type = '' OR fraud_type = ' ')
  AND (duplicate_label IS NULL OR duplicate_label = '' OR duplicate_label = ' ')
  AND user_id > 0
  AND ads_id > 0
  AND item_id > 0
```

### 广告位与出价类型过滤
```sql
WHERE pricing_type = 11               -- ROI3 Target CPC
  AND ads_placement = 40              -- Search/Discovery
WHERE ads_placement IN (40, 50, 0, 3, 2003)
```

### 流控实验组过滤
```sql
WHERE campaign_id % 100 >= 60
  AND campaign_id % 100 < 80          -- flow_control2 group
```

### 券过滤
```sql
WHERE bid_voucher_id > 0              -- has voucher impression
  AND operation = 1
```

### 时间范围过滤
```sql
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('2025-07-21') AND date('2025-07-25')
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### JOIN with dwd_advertise_performance_di (request-level dedup join)
```sql
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_di__reg_s0_live a
JOIN mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live b
  ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region
 AND a.grass_date = b.grass_date
 AND a.ads_id = b.ads_id
 AND a.shop_id = b.shop_id
 AND a.campaign_id = b.campaign_id
 AND a.ads_request_id = b.request_id
 AND cast(a.ads_entrance as integer) = b.entrance
 AND a.ads_placement = b.placement
```

### LEFT JOIN with ads_advertise_mkt_1d (ROI2 item metrics)
```sql
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live mkt
  ON a.item_id = mkt.item_id
 AND a.shop_id = mkt.shop_id
 AND mkt.tz_type = 'local'
 AND mkt.grass_date = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
```

### Self-JOIN (impression vs click dedup by item_id + placement)
```sql
-- Impression base
FROM (SELECT ... FROM tracking_item_di WHERE operation = 1 GROUP BY ...) I
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ... FROM tracking_item_di WHERE operation = 2 GROUP BY ...
) C
  ON I.grass_region = C.grass_region
 AND I.item_id = C.item_id
 AND I.placement = C.placement
```

## Common Aggregations

### 曝光/点击计数
```sql
SUM(IF(operation = 1, 1, 0)) AS impression_cnt
SUM(IF(operation = 2, 1, 0)) AS click_cnt
COUNT(1) AS total_cnt
```

### 扣费金额
```sql
-- 单条 dedup 后聚合
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY grass_region, grass_date, ads_entrance, ads_id, shop_id,
                 ads_request_id, campaign_id, ads_placement, timestamp
    ORDER BY internal.deduction_info.deduction_price DESC
) AS rn
-- WHERE rn = 1
SUM(COALESCE(internal.deduction_info.deduction_price, 0)) AS click_deduction_price
```

### 算法预估字段提取
```sql
MAX(CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(item_json_data, '$.pCTR') AS DOUBLE)) AS pCTR
MAX(CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(item_json_data, '$.pCR') AS DOUBLE)) AS pCR
MAX(CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(item_json_data, '$.broad_pcr') AS DOUBLE)) AS broad_pcr
MAX(CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(item_json_data, '$.rank_score') AS DOUBLE)) AS rank_score
MAX(CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(item_json_data, '$.padvv') AS DOUBLE)) AS padvv
JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(item_json_data, '$.entrance') AS entrance
```

### Voucher/券相关
```sql
MAX(item_voucher.display_ads_voucher_label) AS display_ads_voucher_label
JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(CAST(item_voucher AS JSON), '$.display_ads_voucher_label') = '1'
SUM(IF(is_roi3_best_voucher = 1, 1, 0)) AS roi3_best_voucher_impression_cnt
```

### 广告位归一化 (Placement Normalization)
```sql
CASE
    WHEN tracking_placement IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 5) THEN coalesce(ads_placement, tracking_placement)
    ELSE coalesce(tracking_placement, 0)
END AS placement
```

### Voucher 标签分组
```sql
CASE
    WHEN pricing_type NOT IN (11, 15) THEN array('__ALL__')
    WHEN pricing_type IN (11, 15) AND bid_voucher_id IS NOT NULL
         AND coalesce(max(display_ads_voucher_label), 999) != 1 THEN array('roi3.0', '__ALL__')
    WHEN pricing_type IN (11, 15) AND bid_voucher_id IS NOT NULL
         AND max(display_ads_voucher_label) = 1 THEN array('roi3.0_display', 'roi3.0', '__ALL__')
    ELSE array('no_voucher', '__ALL__')
END AS voucher_types
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: 流控超投检测 — 按 request_id 去重后 JOIN perf 表
```sql
SELECT
    grass_region, grass_date,
    cast(ads_entrance as integer) as entrance,
    ads_id, shop_id, ads_request_id as request_id, campaign_id, ads_placement,
    round(sum(coalesce(internal.deduction_info.deduction_price, 0)), 2) as click_deduction_price
FROM (
    SELECT *, row_number() over (
        partition by grass_region, grass_date, ads_entrance, ads_id,
                     shop_id, ads_request_id, campaign_id, ads_placement, timestamp
        order by internal.deduction_info.deduction_price desc
    ) as rn
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = date('${RUN_TIME}')
      AND operation = 2
      AND user_id > 0 AND ads_id > 0 AND item_id > 0
      AND (fraud_type is null or fraud_type = '' or fraud_type = ' ')
      AND (duplicate_label is null or duplicate_label = '' or duplicate_label = ' ')
      AND pricing_type = 11 AND ads_placement = 40
) t WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date, ads_entrance, ads_id, shop_id, ads_request_id, campaign_id, ads_placement
```

### Snippet 2: ROI3 券曝光计数
```sql
SELECT
    grass_date, grass_region, ads_id, pricing_type, ads_entrance,
    SUM(IF(json_extract_scalar(cast(item_voucher as json), '$.display_ads_voucher_label') = '1', 1, 0)) AS ads_voucher_display_cnt
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
  AND bid_voucher_id > 0
  AND operation = 1
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
```

### Snippet 3: PCOC 校准 — 曝光/点击与算法预估对比
```sql
WITH tracking_tb AS (
    SELECT
        grass_date, grass_region, ads_placement,
        cast(pricing_type as int) as pricing_type,
        cast(json_extract_scalar(item_json_data, '$.entrance') as bigint) as entrance,
        sum(if(operation = 1, 1, 0)) as impression_cnt,
        sum(if(operation = 1, cast(json_extract_scalar(item_json_data, '$.pCTR') as double), 0)) as expected_click,
        sum(if(operation = 2, 1, 0)) as click_cnt,
        sum(if(operation = 2, cast(json_extract_scalar(item_json_data, '$.pCR') as double), 0)) as expected_order,
        sum(if(operation = 2, internal.deduction_info.bidprice, 0)) as cost
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
      AND grass_region in ('ID', 'MY', 'TW', 'SG', 'PH', 'VN', 'BR', 'TH')
      AND ads_placement in (40)
      AND operation <= 2 AND ads_id > 0
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
)
```

### Snippet 4: 填充率分析 — 曝光与点击分离统计
```sql
-- Impression
SELECT grass_region, placement, item_id,
    COUNT(1) as total_impression,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ads_id > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ads_impression
FROM (
    SELECT grass_region, placement, ads_id, item_id
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE operation = 1 AND grass_region = upper('${REGION}')
      AND grass_date = date'${bizdate}'
) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
-- Click
SELECT grass_region, placement, item_id,
    COUNT(1) as total_click,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ads_id > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_ads_click
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE operation = 2 AND grass_region = upper('${REGION}')
  AND grass_date = date'${bizdate}'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
```

### Snippet 5: 反欺诈 — 点击事件关联减扣记录
```sql
SELECT user_id, shop_id, item_id, ads_id, organic_location as location,
    query.keyword as keyword, fraud_type,
    coalesce(ads_keyword, '') as ads_keyword,
    CASE WHEN tracking_placement IN (0,1,2,3,5) THEN ads_placement

    END AS placement,
    operation, client_ip, device_id, timestamp AS event_timestamp,

WHERE grass_date = DATE('${bizdate}')
  AND operation = 2

```

### Snippet 6: 广告券展示与扣费分析
```sql
SELECT grass_date, grass_region, cast(a.entrance as varchar) as entrance,
    cast(a.pricing_type as varchar) as pricing_type,
    sum(coalesce(a.expenditure_amt_usd, 0)) as expenditure_amt_usd,
    sum(coalesce(a.voucher_deduction_price, 0)) as voucher_deduction_price,
    sum(coalesce(a.deduction_price, 0)) as deduction_price
FROM mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live a
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT grass_date, grass_region, ads_id, pricing_type, ads_entrance,
        sum(if(json_extract_scalar(cast(item_voucher as json), '$.display_ads_voucher_label') = '1', 1, 0)) as ads_voucher_display_cnt
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = date'${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'
      AND bid_voucher_id > 0 AND operation = 1
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
) b ON a.ads_id = b.ads_id AND a.pricing_type = b.pricing_type AND a.entrance = b.ads_entrance
```

### Snippet 7: AB Test Benchmark — target_cir 和 padvv 提取
```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW advertise_tracking_item AS
SELECT user_id, campaign_id, ads_id, ads_request_id, item_id,
    ads_entrance, pricing_type, ads_placement,
    max(coalesce(cast(target_cir as double),
        cast(get_json_object(item_json_data, '$.target_cir') as double))) as target_cir,
    max(cast(if(operation=2, get_json_object(item_json_data, '$.padvv'), null) as double)) as padvv,
    max(case when operation = 1
        and get_json_object(bid_rerank_trace, '$.bid_voucher_id') is not null
        then item_voucher.display_ads_voucher_label end) as display_ads_voucher_label
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}') AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND ads_id > 0 AND ads_placement != 54 AND pricing_type != 29
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8
```

## Write Lineage (生产血缘)

**上游表**: `mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_hi__reg_s0_live`（小时级 Tracking 日志表）

**生产逻辑**: VIEW 定义，从上游小时表全量 SELECT，对 `grass_date` 做时区转换：

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_di__reg_s0_live AS
SELECT ... (all columns)
    ,case when grass_region in ('ID', 'TH', 'VN') then
        DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(grass_date, ' ', lpad(h, 2, 0), ':00:00'), 'UTC+08:00'), 'Asia/Jakarta'))
    when grass_region in ('BR') then
        DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(...), 'America/Araguaina'))
    when grass_region in ('MX') then
        DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(...), 'America/Mexico_City'))
    when grass_region in ('CO') then
        DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(...), 'America/Bogota'))
    when grass_region in ('CL') then
        DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(...), 'America/Santiago'))
    else grass_date
    end as grass_date
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_hi__reg_s0_live
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

### Click Deduction Price (点击扣费)
```sql
-- 从 tracking_item_di 提取单次点击扣费金额，需按 ads_id+request_id+timestamp dedup
ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(internal.deduction_info.deduction_price, 0)), 2) AS click_deduction_price
```

### Voucher Deduction Ad Spend (券扣费广告花费)
```sql
expenditure_amt_usd * (voucher_deduction_price / deduction_price) AS roi3_voucher_expenditure
```

### Overcharge Detection (超投检测)
```sql
-- 如果 tracking 扣费 > 计费系统花费，则判定为超投
click_deduction_price - expenditure_amt_local AS revenue_loss
click_deduction_price > expenditure_amt_local  -- 超投条件
```

### Predicted vs Actual Click (PCOC)
```sql
-- Tracking 侧: 预估点击 = SUM(pCTR) over operation=1
SUM(IF(operation = 1, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(item_json_data, '$.pCTR') AS DOUBLE), 0)) AS expected_click
-- Performance 侧: 实际点击
SUM(click_cnt) AS actual_click
```

### adstype fill rate (广告位填充率)
```sql
SUM(CASE WHEN ads_id > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ads_impression  -- 有广告的曝光
COUNT(1) AS total_impression                                        -- 总曝光
-- fill_rate = ads_impression / total_impression
```

### ROI3 Voucher Display Rate
```sql
-- 券展示率 = 有 display_ads_voucher_label=1 的曝光 / 总曝光
SUM(IF(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(CAST(item_voucher AS JSON), '$.display_ads_voucher_label') = '1', 1, 0)) AS ads_voucher_display_cnt
```
